paco.notes: Veteran British anchor: bm_george (authority) with 40% bm_lewis (weight, lower centre). Lowest, steadiest en-GB male of the auditions (median F0 ~135 Hz, pitch IQR ~4.5 st), best recogniser score of the four Paco takes. Speed hits WORLD NOW's 163 wpm with the bible's longer pauses (the calm is in the pauses, the words run ~185 wpm). Keep bm_george/bm_daniel/bm_lewis out of any other voice so nobody sounds like Paco.

lola.notes: Co-anchor, warm and curious: af_heart with 25% af_bella. Chosen over the sharper af_heart+af_sarah blend, which measured too close to Penny (Bhattacharyya 0.30), and over af_heart+af_kore, too close to Nova (0.6 st). ~7 st above Paco plus the accent contrast (en-US vs en-GB). WORLD NOW pace 171 wpm, same pause set as Paco so the two read as one programme.

max.notes: Technology correspondent, quick and keen but adult: am_fenrir with 40% am_puck. Highest, brightest US male (median F0 ~131 Hz, widest pitch movement of the cast, ~6.4 st IQR) so his enthusiasm is in the melody, never in volume. ~3 st above Sam; opposite gender and accent to Ada. TECH BYTES pace 175 wpm.

ada.notes: Sceptical analyst, clear explainer: bf_emma with 30% af_sarah, read with en-GB phonemes (accent stays British). Same recogniser score as pure Emma with more question intonation (pitch IQR 3.9 vs 3.0 st). Distinct from Penny (the other British woman) by timbre (Bhattacharyya ~0.73, cepstral distance ~12.3 dB) rather than pitch, since their profiles share a pitch. TECH BYTES pace 166 wpm, ~9 wpm under Max.

nova.notes: Astrophysicist, warm and precise: af_nova with 25% af_alloy and 20% af_kore. Lowest, darkest female voice of the cast (median F0 ~155 Hz), best recogniser score of the Nova takes, 4.7 st under Lola so the two American women never blur. COSMOS pace 145 wpm with the bible's pauses; the words themselves stay above 150 wpm on her copy. Owner 3 Oct: 10% faster (speed 0.81 -> 0.89, pauses 10% shorter).

unit8.notes: Robot co-host, deadpan but charming: base am_echo with 30% am_fenrir, effect 'robot-soft' (owner 3 Oct picked A of four: mostly the voice itself with a gentle machine sheen, no buzz, no crush; the classic 'robot' was a monotone 100 Hz vocoder below 2.4 kHz and read odd and annoying). Chosen for intelligibility under the effect: pure am_echo and am_onyx+am_echo lose consonants (21% recogniser errors on the news sentence, vs 3%). Keep speed >= 0.82: slower speeds measurably smear the vocoder (15-18% errors at 0.78-0.80). The deliberate pace (~135 wpm, top of the COSMOS range) comes from a 0.48 s beat at full stops; for slower, lengthen pauses, never lower the speed.

penny.notes: Markets correspondent, numbers first: bf_isabella with 25% af_kore and 15% bf_alice (en-GB phonemes). The clearest of the four Penny takes on figures at equal speed (recogniser errors 26% vs 37-54%), and no bf_emma so she stays distinct from Ada. MONEY MINUTE pace 170 wpm, 0.40 s at full stops.

sam.notes: Relaxed rolling-news anchor: am_michael with 25% am_onyx. Lowest, darkest voice of the cast (median F0 ~109 Hz), steady, friendly; ~3 st under Max. NEWS IN 60 pace 175 wpm (speed ~1.19: Michael articulates slowly, so this does not sound rushed); urgency comes from the cuts, never from the voice.

rhea.notes: Europe & Africa correspondent (WORLD NOW links, owner 4 Oct): bf_lily with 25% bf_emma for clarity (Emma alone is Ada's base). Measured on the link test copy (40-band mel cepstrum, coefficients 1-12): nearest Penny 73.4, Max 75.4, Ada 80.7, more than the cast's own closest pair (Nova-continuity 60.3, Lola-Nova 67.3); median F0 ~194 Hz, pitch IQR 5.7 st (a livelier melody than Ada's 3.1). Blends with af_aoede or bf_isabella drifted to Lola/Penny (51-66) and were dropped. WORLD NOW pause set.

vic.notes: Americas correspondent (WORLD NOW links, owner 4 Oct): am_eric with 30% am_onyx (Sam has 25% onyx, but Sam is >79 away). Nearest voices on the link test copy: Nova 69.1 (another gender), continuity 72.5, Penny 78.9; every male presenter further (Paco, whom he follows in a two-way, >79). Median F0 ~130 Hz, IQR 4.8 st. am_liam/am_adam blends sat on Paco (53-63) and were dropped. WORLD NOW pause set.

mika.notes: Asia & Middle East correspondent (WORLD NOW links, owner 4 Oct): af_aoede alone, the best-graded Kokoro voice no presenter used. Nearest on the link test copy: Nova 72.3 (+2.6 st), Lola 81.9 (-1.6 st). Every blend with af_river/af_jessica pulled it onto Lola (40-48), so it stays pure. Median F0 ~179 Hz, IQR 4.4 st. WORLD NOW pause set.

continuity.notes: Continuity announcer for breaks, idents and the UP NEXT promo (not a presenter): bm_fable, the en-GB voice no presenter uses, as docs/programmes/channel-and-breaks.md asks; read at ~150 wpm, slower than the anchors.

omar.notes: Experts (owner 9 Oct, server/experts.js): measured on an analyst's answer (40-band mel cepstrum, coefficients 1-12; the cast's own closest pairs are 63-66), with the recogniser's word error rate on the same copy. Economics Editor, measured and plain: am_adam with 40% am_onyx (the low end of the cast, median F0 ~109 Hz, IQR 3.9 st), read with en-GB phonemes. Nearest Vic 66, Lola 66; Penny (MONEY MINUTE) and Paco further. WER 0.09. Blends with hm_omega or am_santa sat on Sam or Max (54-59).

Diplomatic Correspondent, calm and exact: ff_siwis (a French voice, read with en-GB phonemes: a cooler, more precise colour) and af_sky in equal parts (no advert's lead voice dominates: cloudbrella leads with af_sky, 37 away). Nearest Penny 64, Rhea 70, Lola further; median F0 ~178 Hz, IQR 4.4 st. WER 0.05. Every af_river blend sat on Rhea (38-44).

tomas.notes: Experts (owner 9 Oct, server/experts.js): measured on an analyst's answer (40-band mel cepstrum, coefficients 1-12; the cast's own closest pairs are 63-66), with the recogniser's word error rate on the same copy. Planetary scientist, warm and unhurried: am_santa (the oldest-sounding Kokoro voice) with 40% am_onyx to steady it; the widest melody of the experts (IQR 7.9 st, median F0 ~128 Hz), slower at speed 1 than the rest. Nearest UNIT-8 51 (heard on air through its robot effect) and Sam 53 (never on COSMOS); Nova far. WER 0.09.

june.notes: Experts (owner 9 Oct, server/experts.js): measured on an analyst's answer (40-band mel cepstrum, coefficients 1-12; the cast's own closest pairs are 63-66), with the recogniser's word error rate on the same copy. Security and hardware analyst, quick and precise: af_jessica alone, the brightest of the experts (median F0 ~205 Hz). Nearest Lola 75, Rhea 81; Ada and Max (TECH BYTES) far. WER 0.02. Kept pure: blends with af_sky or af_nicole drifted onto Lola (48-53).

amara.notes: Experts (owner 9 Oct, server/experts.js): measured on an analyst's answer (40-band mel cepstrum, coefficients 1-12; the cast's own closest pairs are 63-66), with the recogniser's word error rate on the same copy. Health Correspondent, a doctor who reassures where the facts allow: hf_alpha (a Hindi voice) with 50% af_river, read with en-GB phonemes. Nearest Lola 55, Penny 57, Rhea 59 (more than any other blend tried: af_river with if_sara, pf_dora or jf_gongitsune sat on Rhea, 26-44); median F0 ~194 Hz. WER 0.12, the cast's usual range.

Culture Correspondent, lively and generous: am_liam with 40% im_nicola (an Italian voice, read with en-GB phonemes: a warmer, rounder colour than Dev's pure am_liam, 55 away). Nearest Sam 60, Paco 63; median F0 ~114 Hz. WER 0.07.

ines.notes: Experts (owner 9 Oct, server/experts.js): measured on an analyst's answer (40-band mel cepstrum, coefficients 1-12; the cast's own closest pairs are 63-66), with the recogniser's word error rate on the same copy. Legal Affairs Correspondent, careful and crisp: ef_dora (a Spanish voice, read with en-US phonemes) with 45% af_sky. Nearest UNIT-8 63, Sam 65, Vic 68; every WORLD NOW voice further; median F0 ~167 Hz. WER 0.02. Led by ef_dora rather than af_sky (the cloudbrella advert's lead), which also moved her further from the cast (62 -> 63+). Clara shares af_sky (37 apart), but they differ by accent (en-US / en-GB), pace and a Spanish against a French colour, and one analysis airs per programme.
